next_actions: Finish and independently read back the live QfO large-only/medium-only branch ablations and fresh HMM cap trial; preserve queued scoring recovery without duplicate inference.

Evaluate any proposed mechanism across primary endpoint vectors with a reproduced control; do not select reference-family-specific rules, blindly discard medium-confidence pairs, or treat species-marker stabilization as a proven standalone fix.

scientific_interpretation: Most observed recall recovery reunites previously separated candidate families, while a smaller set of correct assignments is lost. This motivates candidate-context and phylogenetic discrimination work, not indiscriminate merging.

Many remaining candidate-separated reference pairs already have two initial directed HMM hits. More search sensitivity alone is not established as the remedy; graph admission, clustering, refinement and expansion remain plausible bottlenecks.
584 co-candidate omissions cannot be attributed to gene-tree accuracy or membership filtering from stage labels alone.
60 rescued pairs have no retained initial directed hits. Do not impose a universal direct-HMM-hit requirement on native ortholog pairs.
Functional similarity decline and OrthoBench regression still invalidate combined deferral as a general default.
